laws: Shared World invariant is a proof interface, not a universal domain model.
Shared proof coordinates bind subject, owner, body, scope, admission and occurrence; owner-native semantics remain opaque.
Cognition may be required inside Game admission without becoming a universal World coordinate.
Migration/generation may be required inside Security scope without becoming a universal World coordinate.
Planning/Intent may be required inside Game scope without becoming a universal World coordinate.
Owner identity is required to interpret owner-native Body, scope, admission and occurrence evidence without a global World namespace.
limitations: This is a research proof projection, not a production schema.
Trusted-local owner-authored evidence is assumed; issuer authentication across an untrusted relay is not proven.
The experiment compares two positive bounded occurrence domains, not persistent Presence.
A third materially different consumer has not yet tested whether all six coordinates remain minimal.
The ownerId necessity is architectural: current Body/evidence references are owner-native rather than globally namespaced; no untrusted issuer-authentication mechanism is added here.
The proof interface describes a bounded occurrence, not persistent ambient Presence.
